# 🤖 ONE-CLICK Bot Installation Guide (100% FREE - VERIFIED)

All configuration files are ready! Just click these links to install:

## ✅ 3 FREE Bots to Install (Takes 2 Minutes Total):

### 1. **Codecov** - Test Coverage Reports
**Link:** https://github.com/apps/codecov  
**Cost:** 🟢 **FREE forever** for public repos  
**What it does:** Shows which code is tested and which isn't

**Installation:**
- Click "Install it for free"
- Select "Locvel" organization
- Choose "Only select repositories" → Check "voite"
- Click "Install"
- ✅ Configuration file already added: `codecov.yml`

---

### 2. **All Contributors Bot** - Recognize Contributors
**Link:** https://github.com/apps/allcontributors  
**Cost:** 🟢 **FREE forever** (open source)  
**What it does:** Automatically recognizes all types of contributions (code, docs, design, etc.)

**Installation:**
- Click "Install it for free"
- Select "Locvel" organization
- Choose "Only select repositories" → Check "voite"
- Click "Install"
- ✅ Configuration file already added: `.all-contributorsrc`

---

### 3. **ImgBot** - Automatic Image Optimization
**Link:** https://github.com/apps/imgbot  
**Cost:** 🟢 **FREE forever** for public repos  
**What it does:** Optimizes PNG/JPG images to reduce file size (saves bandwidth)

**Installation:**
- Click "Install it for free"
- Select "Locvel" organization
- Choose "Only select repositories" → Check "voite"
- Click "Install"
- ✅ Configuration file already added: `.imgbotconfig`

---

## 🚀 Already Active (No Installation Needed):

These are already working in your repo:
- ✅ **Dependabot** - Dependency updates (GitHub built-in)
- ✅ **Stale Bot** - Closes inactive issues/PRs (GitHub Actions)
- ✅ **Greetings Bot** - Welcomes new contributors (GitHub Actions)
- ✅ **Auto Labeler** - Labels PRs automatically (GitHub Actions)
- ✅ **CodeQL Security** - Security scanning (GitHub Actions)
- ✅ **CI/CD Pipeline** - Tests and builds (GitHub Actions)

---

## ⚠️ Important Notes:

### Why NOT Renovate?
- You already have **Dependabot** for dependency updates
- Running both would create **duplicate PRs** (confusing and wasteful)
- Dependabot is built into GitHub (easier to maintain)

### Compatibility:
All 3 bots above are **compatible** with each other and with your existing setup:
- Codecov works with CI/CD ✅
- All Contributors works independently ✅
- ImgBot works independently ✅
